changes.catalogueSays: commercial-code 173 التنبيه بالإخلاء وأجله / Notice to vacate and its time limit
changes.reason: [commercial-code 173 ¶1] ends a lease only by a notice given at least six months before the term, and [commercial-code 173 ¶5] requires an extrajudicial act with reasons and the recital of article 194 on pain of nullity; both are imported from the formal-notice module, and [commercial-code 173 ¶2] (tacit extension without notice) is added.

changes.catalogueSays: commercial-code 176 تعويض الاستحقاق عند رفض التجديد / Eviction indemnity when renewal is refused
changes.reason: [commercial-code 176 ¶1] makes the lessor who refuses renewal pay the eviction indemnity equal to the harm, outside the exceptions of [commercial-code 177 ¶1]; [commercial-code 176 ¶2] lists its heads and lets the owner prove a lower harm.

changes.catalogueSays: commercial-code 187 مكرر عقود الإيجار المبرمة بعد تعديل 2005: الخروج عند انتهاء الأجل دون تعويض ما لم يتفق على خلافه / Leases after the 2005 reform: vacate at term without indemnity unless agreed
changes.reason: [commercial-code 187 مكرر ¶2] carries the catalogue's reading and is imported from the formal-notice module; [commercial-code 187 مكرر ¶1] is added: leases made from the law's publication are in official form on pain of nullity.

changes.catalogueSays: الحكم بإخلاء المدعى عليه من المحل التجاري الكائن بـ (...)
changes.reason: Rests on [commercial-code 173 ¶1] for a pre-reform lease and [commercial-code 187 مكرر ¶2] for a later one, subject to [commercial-code 187 ¶1] (the tenant owed an indemnity stays until paid).

changes.catalogueSays: أو: إلزام المؤجر بأداء تعويض الاستحقاق، واحتياطيا تعيين خبير لتقديره
